propositions: Add tri-state bridge_project field (absent/empty/key) and repos list field to ticket state schema and reducer with projection on CREATE and EDIT events
Expose --bridge-project and --repos create-time arguments on all three write surfaces (CLI, library, MCP) with identical state outcomes
Implement promote-only edit-time guard on bridge_project that rejects changes to already-bound tickets while allowing unbound ticket edits, with repos remaining freely editable
Repos field is freely editable and never reaches tracker; bridge_project is synced to tracker and guarded by binding state check via existing bindings.json reader
Support all three bridge_project states (absent for legacy, empty string for never-sync, key for sync-to-project) as distinguishable after replay
Maintain backward compatibility: tickets created before this change replay to identical state except for absent new fields
